snippet.title: Warhammer 40,000: Mechanicus II – Launch Trailer | Warhammer Skulls 2026
snippet.description:
Two factions, two campaigns, one epic conflict. Out now on Windows PC, PlayStation®5 & Xbox Series X|S.

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2532480/Warhammer_40000_Mechanicus_II/
PlayStation 5: https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10008848
Xbox: https://www.microsoft.com/store/productid/9n3b790rkwtw
Epic: https://store.epicgames.com/p/warhammer-40k-mechanicus-edf53b

Watch the official launch trailer for Warhammer 40,000: Mechanicus II, centred on the bitter rivalry between Magos Dominus Faustinius and Vargard Nefershah as the Adeptus Mechanicus and the Necrons collide in a war for the fate of a world.

Command the techno-religious forces of the Adeptus Mechanicus or lead the deathless legions of the Necrons across two full narrative campaigns, each offering its own distinct tactical and strategic challenges.

Featuring turn-based tactical combat, strategic campaign decisions and the return of the acclaimed Mechanicus atmosphere and soundtrack.

See all the Skulls 2026 reveals on Warhammer Community: https://www.warhammer-community.com/en-gb/articles/2eknkrto/skulls-2026-the-warhammer-video-games-festival/

Follow for more Warhammer, more often:

- Sign up for Warhammer+: https://www.warhammerplus.com/
- Warhammer 40,000 on YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@OfficialWarhammer40000
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/warhammerofficial/
- Threads: https://www.threads.net/@warhammerofficial
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/WarhammerOfficial/
- Warhammer Community: https://www.warhammer-community.com/
- Get Warhammer in your inbox: https://ow.ly/6SJq50T3NL1"
